description: This file defines the TerminationReasonMenuConfigurator class in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It implements a menu configuration for the termination reasons view, overriding the screen when invoked.

classes.name: TerminationReasonMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Class responsible for configuring the menu related to termination reasons in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It uses traits to help override screen details.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the configure method to set the screen to 'viewTerminationReasons' when invoked, without returning any menu item.
